quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the benefits of playing against real NBA pros
quotes.excerpt: it was good to get out there and get a run against some real pros
quotes.quote: I felt great. It was good to get out there and get a run against some real pros, not just Summer League, so it was really beneficial.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on his first NBA run against real pros: It was good to get out there and get a run against some real pros, not just Summer League, so it was really beneficial.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the fast pace and physicality of his first NBA game
quotes.excerpt: the pace is a lot faster than I anticipated
quotes.quote: The pace is a lot faster than I anticipated. I knew it was going to be fast, but it is pretty fast out there. Obviously, guys are physical, so I would say those two things probably.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on the adjustment to the NBA: The pace is a lot faster than I anticipated. I knew it was going to be fast, but it is pretty fast out there.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the defensive skills needed to earn a rotation spot
quotes.excerpt: me being able to hit an open shot, my rim protection, a lot of defensive stuff
quotes.quote: Me being able to hit an open shot, my rim protection, a lot of defensive stuff, being active offensively, but I would say mostly my defense.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on what he needs to do to earn a rotation spot: Me being able to hit an open shot, my rim protection, a lot of defensive stuff, being active offensively, but I would say mostly my defense.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile

quotes.quote: I am just being where my feet are at, learning from the vets, Nikola especially, AG. They have been real good for me.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on Nikola Jokic's dominance
quotes.excerpt: he is the best player in the world
quotes.quote: He is the best player in the world, so it is crazy to sit and watch what he does on a day-to-day.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on Nikola Jokic: He is the best player in the world, so it is crazy to sit and watch what he does on a day-to-day.

quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on seeing Nikola Jokic up close: I could just see how dominant he is. When you see it on TV, it is different than seeing it in person.

quotes.speaker: Trevon Brazile
quotes.summary_phrase: Trevon Brazile on the veteran leadership of Tyus Jones
quotes.excerpt: he is just always talking, giving us learning points
quotes.quote: He is just always talking, giving us learning points. Me and Bryce, being new to this league, he has been one of the main guys that has been teaching me a lot on and off the court, so his veteran leadership is definitely helpful.
quotes.social_post: Trevon Brazile on the impact of Tyus Jones: He is just always talking, giving us learning points. He has been one of the main guys that has been teaching me a lot on and off the court.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on transitioning from scorer to playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I am just a natural scorer, so being put in them playmaking situations, I am thinking score first
quotes.quote: I am just a natural scorer, so being put in them playmaking situations, I am thinking score first, so just trying to be more of a playmaker, being able to make plays for guys, hit the roller, hit the skip, things like that.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on evolving his game: I am just a natural scorer, so being put in them playmaking situations, I am thinking score first, so just trying to be more of a playmaker.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on reading the defense while handling the ball
quotes.excerpt: understanding who is helping from where and what guys they are helping off of
quotes.quote: It is reading, you know, help side and low man and understanding who is helping from where and what guys they are helping off of. If you have a guy like Cam Johnson in the corner, you want to fire it early so you can get a clean look.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on reading the floor: It is reading help side and low man and understanding who is helping from where and what guys they are helping off of.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on Trevon Brazile's versatility
quotes.excerpt: I think he is more than an athlete
quotes.quote: With Trevon, I think he is more than an athlete, and he is showcasing that. Obviously, he is a great defender, he can shoot it with confidence, and I think that the things that he brings to the game are things that we are lacking as a unit.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on Trevon Brazile: He is more than an athlete. He is a great defender, he can shoot it with confidence, and he brings things to the game that we are lacking as a unit.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on the connectivity of the second unit

quotes.quote: It is easy to play with these guys and guys are finding each other in their spots, and I think as time goes on, it is just going to get better and better.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on the second unit chemistry: It is easy to play with these guys and guys are finding each other in their spots, and I think as time goes on, it is just going to get better.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on playing with Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I used to play with the Raptors on 2K just so I could wear the Camo jerseys
quotes.quote: Playing with a guy that scored at the highest level, 26,000 points. I was telling Demar, I used to play with the Raptors on 2K just so I could wear the Camo jerseys and play with Demar and dunk on people.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on playing with Demar DeRozan: I used to play with the Raptors on 2K just so I could wear the Camo jerseys and play with Demar and dunk on people.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on his connection with Andrew Nembhard and Ryan
quotes.excerpt: I played with Andrew Nembhard at school and Ryan used to come down and visit Andrew
quotes.quote: I played with Andrew Nembhard at school and Ryan used to come down and visit Andrew, so we would all kick it together all the time and just since then we have kept the friendship going.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on his friendship with Andrew Nembhard: We would all kick it together all the time and just since then we have kept the friendship going.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the second unit's transition play
quotes.excerpt: the second unit was pretty good, they run on stunts transition
quotes.quote: The second unit was pretty good, they run on stunts transition, and they got us a lot of extra opportunities, which we have not done over the years, especially last year.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the second unit: The second unit was pretty good, they run on stunts transition, and they got us a lot of extra opportunities, which we have not done over the years.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Manuel Miller's performance
quotes.excerpt: seeing him get a bucket, just stuff like that is cool
quotes.quote: Even a few minutes of opportunity, Manuel Miller, seeing him get a bucket, just stuff like that is cool because those guys put so much on tape for whether they play for us or another team.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Manuel Miller: Even a few minutes of opportunity, seeing him get a bucket, just stuff like that is cool because those guys put so much on tape.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Christian Braun's explosive play
quotes.excerpt: the dunk obviously, just to the explosion
quotes.quote: The dunk obviously, just to the explosion. But early in the game, they called timeout where he ran his route, I said it last year all the time, like guys like an NFL player, and you hit him in the middle of the floor, you got an easy basket.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Christian Braun: He is like an NFL player, and you hit him in the middle of the floor, you got an easy basket.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the importance of jump defense
quotes.excerpt: Tias got the three in the corner the one time, Aaron got two
quotes.quote: Tias got the three in the corner the one time, Aaron got two. He missed one, but it was a really good execution where he is right at the rim with the cross match.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on defensive execution: It was a really good execution where he is right at the rim with the cross match.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the rotation of the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: I am going to rotate that spot, I will get different key opportunities
quotes.quote: I am going to rotate that spot, I will get different key opportunities. And I thought, you know, with Markkanen and Jackson, why wait? Welcome to the NBA, man. These are two former All-Stars, former Defensive Player of the Year.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on rotation plans: I am going to rotate that spot. I will get different key opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the development of Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: this is a work in progress for me
quotes.quote: With Jamal, this is a work in progress for me. I used to play with Tim a really long stretch when we were fully healthy, and some guys that is fair to, Tim could do it. I got to find out what Jamal's comfortability is with that.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Jamal Murray: This is a work in progress for me. I got to find out what Jamal's comfortability is with that.
